import sys
import math

DEBUG = True
name = "I"

class FastScanner:
    def __init__(self, file_name=None, stream=None):
        if file_name:
            self.dis = open(file_name, 'rb')
        elif stream:
            self.dis = stream
        else:
            self.dis = sys.stdin.buffer
        self.buffer = bytearray(1 << 17)
        self.pointer = 0

    def next_byte(self):
        if self.pointer == len(self.buffer):
            self.dis.readinto(self.buffer)
            self.pointer = 0
        byte = self.buffer[self.pointer]
        self.pointer += 1
        return byte

    def next_string(self):
        ret = []
        b = self.next_byte()
        while b <= 32:
            b = self.next_byte()
        while b > 32:
            ret.append(chr(b))
            b = self.next_byte()
        return ''.join(ret)

def main():
    if DEBUG:
        scan = FastScanner()
        out = sys.stdout
    else:
        scan = FastScanner(name + ".in")
        out = open(name + ".out", "w")
    N = float(scan.next_string())
    P = float(scan.next_string())

    for i in range(int(N)+1):
        val = i*(i-1)*(i-2)/6 + i*(i-1)*(N - i)/2 + i*(N - i)*(N - i - 1)/4
        val = val / (N*(N-1)*(N-2)/6)

        if val >= P:
            print(i, file=out)
            break
    if not DEBUG:
        out.close()
